build_repeated_scalar_container: build a RepeatedScalarFieldContainer to manage type-checked repeated scalar protobuf fields with append and extend
build_repeated_composite_container: build a RepeatedCompositeFieldContainer to manage repeated composite message fields with add and merge operations
build_scalar_map_container: build a ScalarMap container to manage type-checked dict-like protobuf map fields with scalar values
build_message_map_container: build a MessageMap container to manage dict-like protobuf map fields with nested message values
build_unknown_field_set: build an UnknownFieldSet to store and manage parsed unknown protobuf fields with field numbers and wire types
